evals.prompt: Write a function that lists every operationId in an OpenAPI 3.1 document, typed with the fetcher OpenAPI types.
evals.expected_output: Uses `import type { OpenAPI, Operation } from '@ahoo-wang/fetcher-openapi'`, iterates `doc.paths` PathItems and their method fields, handles optional fields; no runtime import.

evals.prompt: Resolve schema references: given a Schema | Reference from components, return the Schema.
evals.expected_output: Narrows with a `$ref` type guard on `Schema | Reference` slots, looks up `components.schemas` by the ref name, and warns not to apply the guard to PathItem (which has its own `$ref`).

evals.prompt: Add typed x-internal and x-tags extensions to operations and filter out internal ones.
evals.expected_output: Uses `Operation & CommonExtensions` (or Extensible `x-*` keys) and filters on `x-internal`.

evals.prompt: Generate a TypeScript client from our openapi.yaml.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT use this skill: client generation left fetcher in 6.0; $fetcher-v6-migration explains where it went.
